description: This Java class provides utility methods for handling command strategies in the Fineract batch processing module, including parsing query parameters from URLs, removing version prefixes from URLs, and checking if URLs are versioned.

classes.name: CommandStrategyUtils
classes.description: A utility class for handling command URL parsing and version detection in batch processing.

methods.name: getQueryParameters
methods.description: Extracts query parameters from a relative URL into a map.

methods.name: addQueryParametersToUriInfo
methods.description: Adds query parameters to a MutableUriInfo object.

methods.name: relativeUrlWithoutVersion
methods.description: Removes version prefix from a BatchRequest's relative URL.

methods.name: isResourceVersioned
methods.description: Checks if the resource URL in a CommandContext is versioned.

methods.name: isRelativeUrlVersioned
methods.description: Checks if a given relative URL matches the versioned URL pattern.
